```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

candidatos <- c(
  file.path("datos", "dataset.csv"),
  file.path("datos", "Teen_Mental_Health.csv")
)
archivo <- candidatos[file.exists(candidatos)][1]

datos <- read.csv(
  archivo,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
  check.names = FALSE
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    depression_label = as.character(depression_label),
    depresion = if_else(depression_label == "1", "Con depresion", "Sin depresion")
  )
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Observaciones"
list(
  icon = "people",
  color = "primary",
  value = nrow(datos)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Edad promedio"
list(
  icon = "calendar3",
  color = "info",
  value = round(mean(datos$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Horas diarias en redes"
list(
  icon = "phone",
  color = "warning",
  value = round(mean(datos$daily_social_media_hours, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Puntaje de riesgo (media)"
list(
  icon = "heart-pulse",
  color = "danger",
  value = round(mean(datos$mental_health_risk_score, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
)
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Redes sociales y riesgo de salud mental"
p <- ggplot(
  datos,
  aes(
    x = daily_social_media_hours,
    y = mental_health_risk_score,
    color = depresion
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Horas diarias en redes",
    y = "Puntaje de riesgo",
    color = "Depresion"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplotly(p)
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Uso de plataformas"
datos |>
  count(platform_usage, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(platform_usage = fct_reorder(platform_usage, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = platform_usage, y = n, fill = platform_usage)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Bienestar digital"
datos |>
  count(digital_wellbeing_flag) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = digital_wellbeing_flag, y = n, fill = digital_wellbeing_flag)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Indicadores

## Row {height=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Promedios de bienestar"
datos |>
  summarise(
    Sueno = mean(sleep_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    Estres = mean(stress_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ansiedad = mean(anxiety_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Rendimiento academico` = mean(academic_performance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "indicador", values_to = "valor") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = indicador, y = valor, fill = indicador)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(valor, 2)), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Promedio") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Estres segun calidad del sueno"
ggplot(datos, aes(x = sleep_quality, y = stress_level, fill = sleep_quality)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Calidad del sueno", y = "Nivel de estres") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Horas de sueno vs nivel de estres"
p_sueno <- ggplot(datos, aes(x = sleep_hours, y = stress_level, color = sleep_quality)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  labs(
    x = "Horas de sueno",
    y = "Nivel de estres",
    color = "Calidad del sueno"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplotly(p_sueno)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Distribucion del puntaje de riesgo"
ggplot(datos, aes(x = mental_health_risk_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "#2F80ED", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Puntaje de riesgo", y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal()
```
